output.brief: The drop is not mainly about the app, the background checks, or the rival group. It comes from the app and the loss of site coordinators together. The basic RotaWeave tier has no recurring bookings, so a regular only keeps a weekly slot if staff book it before each Thursday release. At Dock Street and Westgate, staff bookings fell from 74 a week to 3 after the coordinator posts ended on 1 May. Of 213 April regulars there, 129 lost their usual slot at least twice, and 88% of them are now inactive, against 11% of those who kept their slot. Two comparison sites back this up. Millbrook has the app but kept its coordinator, and it is stable. Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app, and it is only slightly down. Background checks don't explain it: 121 of the 123 who lapsed had a current check. Commonplate was barely mentioned in callbacks (2 of 61). I'm fairly confident. Don't cancel RotaWeave, suspend checks, or purge the roster. Assign someone to pre-book regulars into their usual slots at Dock Street and Westgate before each Thursday release, phone lapsed volunteers to offer their old slot back, and review after 60 days. Do the same before Quarry Lane goes live on 6 Oct.
